resolution.note: krn pr ship refuses an empty diff against the base (exit 66) and names the merged PR with the same title; the required Check workflow was not changed

title: A pull request with an empty diff against main cannot merge
body:
Why: #643 merged as an empty squash commit (7b34dc7): its change already landed as #642, the PR stayed green, and enabling auto-merge by hand did not look at the diff against main.
Outcome: the required Check fails (or krn pr ship refuses) when the PR's diff against its merge base with main is empty, naming the PR that already carries the change if the title matches one.
Proof: a test feeds an empty diff and expects failure; a non-empty diff passes.
Scope: src/cli/, .github/workflows/, test/.
